## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Kissimmee, United States. It starts at 5800 Water Play Way.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Voted the number one best outdoor water park by USA Today, you and the whole family are in for a wet and wild treat at Aquatica!
>
> Explore an underwater world full of exotic fish, get your adrenaline levels rising on thrilling rides, and even find yourself surrounded by Commerson's dolphins as you speed around the park's enclosed tubes.
>
> From thrilling slides like Riptide Race (the world’s tallest dueling racer) to whimsical fun in Walkabout Waters and more, there are splashy surprises for the whole family. Aquatica’s pools and waterways are even heated to maintain the perfect temperature.
>
> Stay late for family-friendly movies on the beach! Bring a blanket or sit on one of the beach chairs and enjoy a different movie every weekend. Grab some treats from Beachside Panini Bistro and for perfect Polynesian vibes and specialty cocktails, don't miss the new Trader Turi’s Tiki Bar.

## Where this page comes from
